SQL: WITH county_hexes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.hex_id
    FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk h
    WHERE h.County = 'Cameron County'
),

    SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_sovi_hexes
    FROM county_hexes ch
    JOIN VUL_002 v ON ch.hex_id = v.hex_id
    WHERE v.sovi = -999
),
coverage_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_hexes_in_county,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN v.sovi != -999 THEN 1 END) AS hexes_with_sovi,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN v.sovi = -999 THEN 1 END) AS hexes_missing_sovi
    FROM county_hexes ch
    LEFT JOIN VUL_002 v ON ch.hex_id = v.hex_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(h1.hurr_strike_rate_10y AS DOUBLE)), 3)
     FROM county_hexes ch
     JOIN HP_HUR_001 h1 ON ch.hex_id = h1.hex_id) AS avg_hurricane_strike_rate_10y,
    (SELECT SUM(h1.hurr_strike_rate_10y)
     FROM county_hexes ch
     JOIN HP_HUR_001 h1 ON ch.hex_id = h1.hex_id) AS total_hurricane_strikes_10y,
    (SELECT SUM(e1.building_count)
     FROM county_hexes ch

     FROM county_hexes ch

    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(v.sovi AS DOUBLE)), 4)
     FROM county_hexes ch

    (SELECT COUNT(*)

    (SELECT missing_sovi_hexes FROM missing_sovi_count) AS hexes_missing_sovi_data,
    (SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN total_hexes_in_county > 0
            THEN ROUND(CAST(hexes_with_sovi AS DOUBLE) / CAST(total_hexes_in_county AS DOUBLE), 4)
            ELSE 0
        END

tool_calls.output:
SQL: WITH county_hexes AS (
    SELECT
        h.hex_id,
        h.hurr_strike_rate_10y,
        v.sovi
    FROM HP_HUR_001 h
    JOIN VUL_002 v ON h.hex_id = v.hex_id
    JOIN hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x ON h.hex_id = x.hex_id
    WHERE x.County = 'Cameron County'
        AND v.sovi != -999
),
strike_rate_bins AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN hurr_strike_rate_10y = 0 THEN '0'
            WHEN hurr_strike_rate_10y = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN hurr_strike_rate_10y = 2 THEN '2'
            WHEN hurr_strike_rate_10y >= 3 THEN '3+'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS strike_rate_range,
        CASE
            WHEN sovi < 0.25 THEN 'Low (0-0.25)'
            WHEN sovi >= 0.25 AND sovi < 0.5 THEN 'Medium-Low (0.25-0.5)'
            WHEN sovi >= 0.5 AND sovi < 0.75 THEN 'Medium-High (0.5-0.75)'
            WHEN sovi >= 0.75 THEN 'High (0.75-1)'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS sovi_range,
        COUNT(*) AS hex_count
    FROM county_hexes
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    strike_rate_range,
    sovi_range,
    hex_count
FROM strike_rate_bins
ORDER BY
    CASE strike_rate_range

        WHEN '1' THEN 2
        WHEN '2' THEN 3
        WHEN '3+' THEN 4
        ELSE 5

        WHEN 'Medium-High (0.5-0.75)' THEN 3
        WHEN 'High (0.75-1)' THEN 4

tool_calls.question: How many buildings, substations, and power plants are in Galveston County, Texas? Also provide building exposure data and any power infrastructure vulnerability metrics.
tool_calls.output:
SQL: WITH county_filter AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hex_id
    FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk
    WHERE County = 'Galveston County' AND State = 'Texas'
),
missing_sovi_check AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_sovi_count
    FROM VUL_002 v
    JOIN county_filter cf ON v.hex_id = cf.hex_id
    WHERE v.sovi = -999
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.building_count), 0)
     FROM EX_BLD_001 b
     JOIN county_filter cf ON b.hex_id = cf.hex_id) AS total_buildings,
    (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(e.hEE), 2), 0)
     FROM EX_BLD_002 e
     JOIN county_filter cf ON e.hex_id = cf.hex_id) AS total_building_exposure_usd,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.hifld_energy_substations_n), 0)
     FROM "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s
     JOIN county_filter cf ON s.hex_id = cf.hex_id) AS total_substations,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.hifld_energy_plants_n), 0)
     FROM "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" p
     JOIN county_filter cf ON p.hex_id = cf.hex_id) AS total_power_plants,
    (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(v4.psvi_score), 2), 0)
     FROM VUL_004 v4
     JOIN county_filter cf ON v4.hex_id = cf.hex_id) AS avg_psvi_score,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM VUL_004 v4
     JOIN county_filter cf ON v4.hex_id = cf.hex_id
     WHERE v4.psvi_score > 70) AS high_vulnerability_psvi_hexes,
    (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(v2.sovi), 4), 0)
     FROM VUL_002 v2
     JOIN county_filter cf ON v2.hex_id = cf.hex_id
     WHERE v2.sovi != -999) AS avg_sovi_score,
    (SELECT missing_sovi_count FROM missing_sovi_check) AS missing_sovi_data_count

tool_calls.question: What is the hurricane strike rate and hurricane risk score for Galveston County? Also provide data on hurricane building exposure and any power infrastructure vulnerability to hurricanes.
tool_calls.output:
SQL: WITH county_hexes AS (
    SELECT hex_id
    FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk
    WHERE County = 'Galveston County'
),
missing_sovi_check AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_sovi_count
    FROM VUL_002 v
    JOIN county_hexes ch ON v.hex_id = ch.hex_id
    WHERE v.sovi = -999
)
SELECT
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(h.hurr_strike_rate_10y AS DOUBLE)), 3)
     FROM HP_HUR_001 h
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON h.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS avg_hurricane_strike_rate_10y,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(h2.ve_ae_fraction AS DOUBLE)), 3)
     FROM HP_HUR_002 h2
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON h2.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS avg_coastal_surge_susceptibility,
    (SELECT SUM(b.building_count)
     FROM EX_BLD_001 b
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON b.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS total_building_count,
    (SELECT ROUND(SUM(b2.hEE), 2)
     FROM EX_BLD_002 b2
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON b2.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS total_building_economic_exposure_usd,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(v4.psvi_score AS DOUBLE)), 2)
     FROM VUL_004 v4
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON v4.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS avg_power_system_vulnerability_index,
    (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(e.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0))
     FROM "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON e.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS total_power_plants,
    (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(s.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0))
     FROM "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON s.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS total_electrical_substations,
    (SELECT missing_sovi_count FROM missing_sovi_check) AS missing_sovi_rows_count

**Operational Impact:**
For disaster response mobilization, these 51 counties should be prioritized for:
- Enhanced pre-positioning of emergency resources

- Special attention to vulnerable populations during evacuation and recovery operations

tool_calls.output:
SQL: WITH texas_hexes AS (
    SELECT
        x.County,
        v.sovi,
        c.nri_cri_score
    FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x
    JOIN VUL_002 v ON x.hex_id = v.hex_id
    JOIN CR_001 c ON x.hex_id = c.hex_id
    WHERE x.State = 'Texas'
      AND v.sovi != -999
),
county_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        AVG(sovi) AS avg_sovi,
        AVG(nri_cri_score) AS avg_cri,
        COUNT(*) AS hex_count
    FROM texas_hexes
    GROUP BY County
),
statewide_averages AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(avg_sovi) AS state_avg_sovi,
        AVG(avg_cri) AS state_avg_cri
    FROM county_aggregates
)
SELECT
    ca.County,
    ROUND(ca.avg_sovi, 4) AS avg_sovi_score,
    ROUND(ca.avg_cri, 2) AS avg_cri_score,
    ca.hex_count
FROM county_aggregates ca
CROSS JOIN statewide_averages sa
WHERE ca.avg_sovi > sa.state_avg_sovi
  AND ca.avg_cri < sa.state_avg_cri
ORDER BY ca.avg_sovi DESC, ca.avg_cri ASC;

**Critical Infrastructure Analysis:** The DFW region has **1,134 water treatment facilities** across 1,112 hex locations in Dallas, Tarrant, Collin, and Denton counties. This suggests widespread systemic vulnerability to freeze-driven grid loss.

**Grid Dependency Risk:** The data shows **zero water treatment hexes** with co-located power infrastructure (substations or power plants), indicating complete external grid dependency. During Uri-style grid failures, this creates a single point of failure where all water treatment facilities lose power simultaneously.

**Operational Implications:** The causal mechanisms from the knowledge graph highlight that infrastructure systems with high hazard scores and population concentration face amplified impacts. The absence of on-site power generation at water treatment facilities creates a critical failure point where freeze-driven grid loss cascades into water system collapse. Emergency planning must prioritize backup power solutions, particularly for the 217 high-vulnerability locations serving socially vulnerable populations.

- **Infrastructure dependencies** create critical vulnerabilities - hospitals depend on grid power, transportation access, and water systems that are all threatened by flash flooding and extreme heat.

tool_calls.question: Show areas with highest winter storm vulnerability, power infrastructure counts, and population exposure in Texas
tool_calls.output:
SQL: WITH texas_hexes AS (
    SELECT h.hex_id
    FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk h
    WHERE h.State = 'Texas'
),
winter_storm_threshold AS (
    SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(CAST(psvi_score AS DOUBLE), 0.75) AS psvi_p75
    FROM VUL_004 v
    JOIN texas_hexes t ON v.hex_id = t.hex_id
),
high_vulnerability_hexes AS (
    SELECT v.hex_id, v.psvi_score
    FROM VUL_004 v
    JOIN texas_hexes t ON v.hex_id = t.hex_id
    CROSS JOIN winter_storm_threshold wt
    WHERE v.psvi_score > wt.psvi_p75
),
county_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        x.County,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hv.hex_id IS NOT NULL THEN hv.hex_id END) AS high_winter_storm_vulnerability_hex_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(hep.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0)) AS total_power_plants,
        SUM(COALESCE(hes.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0)) AS total_electrical_substations,
        ROUND(AVG(CAST(ep.population_7km AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS avg_population_density_7km,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hv.hex_id IS NOT NULL THEN ep.hex_id END) AS high_vulnerability_populated_hex_count
    FROM texas_hexes th
    JOIN hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x ON th.hex_id = x.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN high_vulnerability_hexes hv ON th.hex_id = hv.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" hep ON th.hex_id = hep.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" hes ON th.hex_id = hes.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN EX_POP_001 ep ON th.hex_id = ep.hex_id
    GROUP BY x.County
    HAVING
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hv.hex_id IS NOT NULL THEN hv.hex_id END) > 0 OR
        SUM(COALESCE(hep.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0)) > 0 OR
        SUM(COALESCE(hes.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0)) > 0 OR
        ROUND(AVG(CAST(ep.population_7km AS DOUBLE)), 2) > 0
)
SELECT
    County,
    high_winter_storm_vulnerability_hex_count,
    total_power_plants,
    total_electrical_substations,
    avg_population_density_7km,
    high_vulnerability_populated_hex_count
FROM county_metrics
ORDER BY
    high_winter_storm_vulnerability_hex_count DESC,
    total_power_plants DESC,
    total_electrical_substations DESC,
    avg_population_density_7km DESC
LIMIT 20;

statewide_totals AS (
    SELECT
        'STATEWIDE_TEXAS' AS region,
        SUM(COALESCE(plants.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0)) AS total_power_plants,
        SUM(COALESCE(substations.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0)) AS total_substations,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(plants.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0) > 0 THEN plants.hex_id END) AS hexes_with_power_plants,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(substations.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0) > 0 THEN substations.hex_id END) AS hexes_with_substations
    FROM ercot_regions er
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" plants ON er.hex_id = plants.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" substations ON er.hex_id = substations.hex_id
),
regional_totals AS (
    SELECT
        er.ercot_region AS region,
        SUM(COALESCE(plants.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0)) AS total_power_plants,
        SUM(COALESCE(substations.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0)) AS total_substations,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(plants.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0) > 0 THEN plants.hex_id END) AS hexes_with_power_plants,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(substations.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0) > 0 THEN substations.hex_id END) AS hexes_with_substations
    FROM ercot_regions er
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" plants ON er.hex_id = plants.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" substations ON er.hex_id = substations.hex_id
    WHERE er.ercot_region != 'Other'
    GROUP BY er.ercot_region
)
SELECT
    region,
    total_power_plants,
    total_substations,
    hexes_with_power_plants,
    hexes_with_substations,
    ROUND(CAST(total_power_plants AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST((SELECT total_power_plants FROM statewide_totals) AS DOUBLE), 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_of_state_plants,
    ROUND(CAST(total_substations AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST((SELECT total_substations FROM statewide_totals) AS DOUBLE), 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_of_state_substations
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM statewide_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM regional_totals
) AS combined
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN region = 'STATEWIDE_TEXAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
    total_power_plants DESC,
    total_substations DESC;
